title: Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of Fire Detection and Alarm System
matching_rationale: Direct match with SEPLE's core fire detection and alarm business. ISRO is a premier government organization. Tender requires supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of addressable fire alarm system with smoke detectors and modules — exactly aligned with company capability. OEM brands Notifier/Morley mentioned in specs align with company's OEM relationships.
scope_summary: Supply, installation, testing and commissioning of an addressable fire detection and alarm system at ISRO Sriharikota campus. Includes addressable fire alarm panels, smoke detectors, MCPs, modules, hooters, and associated wiring. 3-year warranty required.
key_requirements: Addressable fire alarm panel with minimum 4 loops
Compliance with NBC 2016 and IS standards

eligibility_assessment.turnover_requirement: ₹1.5 Cr average annual turnover in last 3 financial years
eligibility_assessment.experience_requirement: Minimum 2 similar completed works of ₹15 Lakh each in fire alarm systems
eligibility_assessment.oem_authorization: Required — MAF from fire alarm panel manufacturer

instant_alert_reason: Strong Fit in core category (Fire Detection & Alarm) with premier government client (ISRO)
